questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Kinetic and/or Tassielink.

Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Kinetic and Tassielink are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.

questions.section: Questions for competitors or potential competitors of Kinetic or Tassielink
questions.text: Does your organisation compete with Kinetic or Tassielink in the supply of bus services in Tasmania? If so, please describe the services you supply in competition with them.

questions.section: Questions for competitors or potential competitors of Kinetic or Tassielink
questions.text: Please describe what is involved in entering and/or expanding into the supply of bus services in Tasmania. If known, please provide details on any inputs, assets or supporting facilities necessary to enter or expand. Do you consider that the Acquisition will change the ease or difficulty of entry?
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
